name: PotPlayer Bridge
description: Launch PotPlayer from Jellyfin Web using secure, expiring, item-scoped original-file streams.
overview: Play Jellyfin library files in PotPlayer without a userscript or companion application.

versions.changelog: Initial public release with Jellyfin Web button injection, Chromium 130+ protocol compatibility, bounded expiring stream tickets, client-address binding, and HTTP Range original-file streaming.
